top_signals.title: Marsh Raises Treasury Allocation to Neutral on Elevated Yields
top_signals.summary: US investment consultancy Marsh is raising its Treasury allocation in some portfolios recommended to clients, a sign that large investors aim to take advantage of elevated yields.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Consulting giant Accenture to pay £18.5m to settle probe into hiring practices
top_signals.summary: New York-listed consultancy giant Accenture has agreed to pay the US government $25m (£18.5m) to settle allegations over its diversity practices. The Department of Justice (DOJ) alleged that Accenture violated federal anti-discrimination requirements while certifying compliance to secure federal contracts.
